name: Poblacion and Kadurong Reefs benchmark survey
description: A baseline ecological survey dataset documenting plankton, fish, and benthic composition and abundance in Poblacion and Kadurong reefs.
evaluation_method: accuracy for ID tasks; RMSE/MAPE for abundance/regression tasks; standard ecological summary statistics for community composition
general_score_metric: task-dependent (accuracy for classification; RMSE/MAPE for abundance estimation)
reputation: A localized ecological baseline dataset valuable for regional reef studies but with limited international adoption.
notes: Small, region-specific survey dataset; non-LLM; class imbalance and seasonal/geographic bias possible; intended as baseline ecological survey data rather than a large-scale benchmarking corpus.
